title: boehmeria zollingeriana var. podocarpa
intro: Boehmeria zollingeriana var. podocarpa, commonly known as the 'False nettle' or 'He Shou Wu', is a plant species belonging to the nettle family (Urticaceae). The health benefits of Boehmeria zollingeriana var. podocarpa include its potential to promote anti-aging, improve cardiovascular health, and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-diabetic properties, making it a valuable component in traditional Chinese medicine. The bioactive constituents of Boehmeria zollingeriana var. podocarpa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
